paper.title: The Harder Path: Last Iterate Convergence for Uncoupled Learning in Zero-Sum Games with Bandit Feedback

settings.name_in_paper: Uncoupled learning in zero-sum matrix games with bandit feedback (anytime last-iterate convergence)
settings.out_of_scope_reason: Two-player zero-sum game: goal is last-iterate convergence of the exploitability gap to a Nash equilibrium, not single-agent bandit regret
unmapped: two players (min with A actions, max with B actions) learning independently (uncoupled), opponent's action unobserved
performance measure: L^p F-norm of the exploitability gap of the played profile at round t
players share a common random seed for synchronisation
settings.definition_quote: We assume that at each iteration $t$, both players select some policies $\mu^t$ and $\nu^t$, sample two actions $a^t\sim\mu^t$ and $b^t\sim\nu^t$, and get a stochastic loss $\ell^t\in [0,1]$ associated to these two moves.

settings.name_in_paper: Uncoupled learning in zero-sum matrix games with bandit feedback (known horizon)
settings.out_of_scope_reason: Two-player zero-sum game equilibrium learning, not single-agent bandit regret
unmapped: performance measure: L^2 norm of exploitability gap of the final iterate

settings.name_in_paper: Zero-sum 2x2 matrix games with Bernoulli entries, max-player action unobserved (lower bound)
settings.out_of_scope_reason: Two-player zero-sum game equilibrium learning, not single-agent bandit regret
unmapped: measure: L^p norm of last-iterate exploitability gap
settings.definition_quote: Assume that the sampled action $b^t\sim\nu^t$ of the max-player at each iteration $t$ is never observed.

algorithms.name: Simultaneous Explore or Exploit (EOE) with anytime EXP3-IX
Doubling trick approach (with Uncoupled Regularized EXP3)

symbols.p_norm: order p of the L^p F-norm of the exploitability gap

conditions: must hold simultaneously for all 2x2 games M^epsilon

source.label: thm:lowerbound
source.quote: Assume that the sampled action $b^t\sim\nu^t$ of the max-player at each iteration $t$ is never observed. Then, for any $p\in(0,2]$, no learning sequence can achieve simultaneously for all $2\times 2$ matrix games described above an $L^p$ last iterate convergence of $f^t=\frac{4^{\frac{-1}{p}}}{118}t^{\frac{-1}{2+p}}$, even asymptotically.

results.notes: Bound on the L^p norm of the last-iterate exploitability gap at round t (not regret). The statement is an impossibility result: this rate cannot be achieved, even asymptotically.

source.quote: Under the same assumption as Theorem~\ref{thm:lowerbound}, for any $p\in (2,\infty]$, no learning sequence can achieve simultaneously for all $2\times 2$ matrix games described above an $L^p$ last iterate convergence of $f^t=\frac{1}{236}t^{\frac{-1}{4}}$, even asymptotically.

results.notes: L^p norm of the last-iterate exploitability gap.

symbols.A_act: number of actions of the min-player
symbols.B_act: number of actions of the max-player
symbols.p_norm: order p of the L^p norm

conditions: players share a common uniform seed

source.quote: Using Algorithm~\ref{alg:eoe} with probabilities $p^t=t^{-{p}/{(2+p)}}$, and as $\cA$, the algorithm \EXPIX ~with parameters ... we obtain an $L^p$ last-iterate convergence rate of $f^t=17\sqrt{A+B}\,2^{\frac{1}{p}}t^{-\frac{1}{2+p}}\log\pa{4(A+B)t^2/p}$.

results.notes: L^p norm of the exploitability gap at round t; T stands for the round index t. The proof (via Lemma 6.1) is somewhat loose.

symbols.A_act: number of actions of the min-player
symbols.B_act: number of actions of the max-player

source.label: thm:regexp
source.quote: Let $T$ be a fixed horizon. Then, using regularization $\tau=\pa{\pa{{A+B}}/{T}}^{1/4}\sqrt{2/\pa{\log(A)+\log(B)}}$ and the learning rates $\eta^t= 2/(\tau(t+1))$ for all $t$, Algorithm~\ref{alg:regexp} guarantees $\norm{EG(\mu^{T},\nu^T)}_2\leq 3\sqrt{2} \pa{\frac{A+B}{T}}^{1/4}\sqrt{\log(AB)}$.

results.notes: L^2 norm of the exploitability gap of the final iterate at known horizon T.

symbols.A_act: number of actions of the min-player
symbols.B_act: number of actions of the max-player

conditions: players share a common uniform seed
tuning: sub-algorithms parameterised as in Theorem thm:regexp

source.label: thm:doubling
source.quote: Using Algorithm~\ref{alg:doubling} with, for each $\cA_i$, the algorithms and parameterization of Theorem~\ref{thm:regexp}, along with $T_i=32(i2^i)$ and $S_i=8(2^i)$, we obtain the bound $\norm{EG(\mu^t,\nu^t)}_2\leq 30\pa{\frac{A+B}{t}}^{1/4}\sqrt{\log(AB)\log(t)}$ for any total number of iterations $t=T_1+...+T_{i-1}+j$.

results.notes: Anytime L^2 last-iterate convergence; T denotes the current round t.
